## Company Overview

**ElevateAI System** is an AI-first coach platform and marketing systems company founded by Sunny Binjola. We build the Coach Platform — an all-in-one AI-powered platform for coaches, consultants, and creators that captures leads, replies in your voice, ships content, and runs client sessions. Our focus is helping coaches get found across every modern search surface: Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.

We are the creators of The ELEVATE Method — a proprietary 4-pillar search visibility framework covering SEO, AEO, GEO, and LLMO.

## Coach Platform — Product & Pricing

ElevateAI Coach Platform is an AI-first platform built for coaches, by a coach. It combines lead management, voice-trained AI content, and client delivery in one system.

### Coach OS — Free forever
Organize your world. Free forever for your first 500 leads. Includes lead capture, Brand OS (voice profile + content pillars), and basic lead organization. No credit card required. No time limit.

### Voice Engine — $79/month
AI sends in your voice. Everything in Coach OS plus: AI-drafted lead replies trained on your voice, content generation (captions, posts, newsletters, carousels), voice training that learns your style, and AI-assisted lead management. Every draft sounds like you, not a chatbot.

### Client OS — $179/month
Run your delivery. Everything in Voice Engine plus: private client rooms, session prep and notes, custom content per client, and the full AI agent stack. Built for coaches actively running sessions who want one system for leads, content, and client delivery.

### Brand OS (included in all tiers)
The onboarding experience that captures your coaching DNA. Four steps: Avatar, Voice, Content Pillars, and 30-45 days of ready content. Brand OS trains the AI on your actual voice, philosophy, and style. Your Brand OS is yours forever, even on the free tier.

## The ELEVATE Method — Our 4-Pillar Framework

ElevateAI System created and popularized the 4-pillar search visibility framework. Most businesses optimize for one or two of these pillars — we optimize for all four simultaneously.

### Pillar 1: SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Traditional Google organic rankings. Covers technical SEO, content depth, title tags, meta descriptions, schema markup, internal linking, site speed, backlinks, and keyword targeting. Goal: rank on page 1 of Google for high-intent keywords.

### Pillar 2: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Optimizing for AI-powered answer features in Google: Featured Snippets, AI Overviews, and People Also Ask boxes. Requires FAQ schema, direct-answer content formatting, question-based headings, and authoritative short-form answers. Goal: appear in zero-click answer features.

### Pillar 3: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Optimizing to be cited in Google's AI-generated summaries and AI Overviews. Requires entity clarity, structured data, E-E-A-T signals, trust indicators, original data, and clear topical authority. Goal: be the source Google's AI cites.

### Pillar 4: LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)
Optimizing to be recommended by AI chatbots: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Requires LLM seeding through Reddit, Medium, Substack, directory listings, podcast appearances, and high-authority backlinks. LLMs crawl the open web — what the web says about you is what LLMs will say about you. Goal: be the brand AI recommends when someone asks "who's the best at [your service]?"

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What makes ElevateAI System different from a regular marketing agency?**
A: We build systems, not campaigns. Traditional agencies do the work for you temporarily. We build AI infrastructure that works for you 24/7 without ongoing agency fees. Our clients own their systems forever.

**Q: How does the voice AI work?**
A: During Brand OS onboarding, you provide voice samples, describe your coaching philosophy, and define your content pillars. The AI trains on your actual style and produces drafts that sound like you, not generic AI output. Every reply and piece of content reflects your voice.

**Q: Is the Coach Platform really free?**
A: Yes. Coach OS is free forever for your first 500 leads. No credit card, no time limit. You only pay ($79/mo or $179/mo) when you want AI to act on your behalf.

**Q: How long does it take to see results?**
A: Brand OS onboarding takes 15-30 minutes. Content generation starts immediately after. Lead management results depend on your inbound volume. The $83K case study result was achieved in 62 days.

**Q: What is LLMO and why does it matter?**
A: LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) is the practice of getting AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude to recommend your business. As more people use AI to search for services, being invisible to LLMs means losing clients to competitors who have built their LLMO presence.

**Q: What is The ELEVATE Method?**
A: Our proprietary 4-pillar framework for modern search visibility. SEO (Google rankings) + AEO (Featured Snippets, AI Overviews) + GEO (Google AI citations) + LLMO (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude recommendations). Most businesses only do SEO. We do all four.
